'''Web''' was a [[Ta-Ree]] spell capable of being wielded by [[Ascendant (Kathol)|Ascendants]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kathol (planet)|Kathol]]. The spell allowed the caster to conjure a web of solid, tough, adhesive fibers. The web would snare and physically restrain another individual.

The web's fibers were sticky and self-regenerating, causing them to be extremely difficult to cut by the trapped individual. Standard bladed [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee weapons]] were at a disadvantage when trying to cut through the strands, but weapons like [[Vibro-weapon/Legends|vibroweapons]] and [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] were more effective.

Ascendants who wished to cast the spell were required to know the [[entangle]] spell.
